parakeet: IQ is a measure, not a verdict. Young Hoon Kim reportedly has an IQ of 276, a number that sounds astronomical, but IQ is not a gold medal for truth. It measures specific kinds of reasoning, especially spatial and abstract pattern recognition. It does not measure critical thinking across disciplines. Accuracy of beliefs, resistance to indoctrination, or emotional intelligence or wisdom. Having the highest IQ on record doesn't mean your beliefs are immune to scrutiny. It just means your pattern recognition engine runs fast. But if the pattern is flawed, speed just takes you to the wrong conclusion faster. So having the highest IQ on record is not equivalent to being the smartest person on the planet.
